name: windows-v141-pinterest-spatial-tray-and-board-import
title: Windows Parity Handoff (v1.4.1): Pinterest Infinite Spatial Browser, Shopping-Cart Tray, Adaptive Pin Detail & Board Collection Import
description: Bring macOS/iOS v1.4.1 native Pinterest capabilities to Windows (Tauri WebView2 + Rust Core + React UI): (1) Persistent Pinterest account sign-in via native WebView2 supporting child OAuth popups (Google/Apple/2FA) and same-origin resource fetching; (2) 120Hz omnidirectional 2D infinite spatial canvas with cursor-anchored continuous zoom, velocity-projected predictive thumbnail prefetching, and proactive outer-ring expansion; (3) Shopping-cart collection tray with horizontal aspect-preserving waterfall layout, selective subset import/removal, and click-to-open Pin detail; (4) Aspect-adaptive floating Pin detail overlay with native Pinterest similar pins waterfall underneath and full-res lightbox preview; (5) Batch import of saved Pinterest collections organized automatically into per-board Charkle folders with incremental Pin ID deduplication.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Keep Windows edits strictly inside windows/. Coordinate with existing GitHub Release v1.4.1 (macOS DMG + iOS IPA already published; replace only the Windows placeholder section when shipping the Windows x64 installer).
